description: The wallet that launched a token and what it did since: when it launched, how much it received, how much it still holds, how much it sold (how many sells, when, and roughly what that's worth), which wallets it sent tokens to and what they hold now. Tokens on Robinhood Chain, Ethereum or Base, or a Solana mint (the dev is whoever paid to create the mint; sells are in SOL). Use for 'is the dev selling?', 'did the dev dump?', 'who launched this?'. To see where the dev's money went on Robinhood Chain, follow up with wallet_flows on the deployer. Works for 0x tokens on Robinhood Chain, Ethereum and Base (pass chain, or it finds the chain); on Ethereum and Base the dev is whoever created the token's contract, and a very busy token is read from its most recent transfers. Premium: 2¢ a call from prepaid agent credits (3 free premium calls a day). Send your agent key as Authorization: Bearer <key>.
